charts.title: K2-32 b: orbits around K2-32
charts.description: The orbits of K2-32's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-32 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Howard et al. 2025 (2025ApJS..278...52H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOWARD_ET_AL__2025): P 8.99196 d

charts.title: K2-32 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-32 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 437444661, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 40 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 130 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 14-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 40 min late; 14-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 43 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
